content.question: Which of the following correctly pairs a problem with an appropriate prevention technique?
options: Overfitting - increase the regularization parameter as much as possible.
Underfitting - reduce the number of features and simplify the model.
Overfitting - use K-fold cross-validation to better estimate generalization ability.
Underfitting - stop training as soon as the validation error starts to rise.
content.answer: Overfitting - use K-fold cross-validation to better estimate generalization ability.
